VDN-2847 (revatimod) Phase 3, Study VDN-2847-P301
Data extract: 2026-10-30 (pre-database-lock extract)
Prepared by: svc-analytics, reviewed by F. Ritter (biostat)

FILES

ADVERSE EVENT SUMMARY INPUTS (use these figures and notes when compiling the AE summary for the FDA briefing package)

EFFICACY (ADAS-Cog13, week 78, LS mean change from baseline)
- Revatimod: -4.1 (SE 0.31)
- Placebo: -1.2 (SE 0.32)
- Placebo-adjusted difference: 2.9 points favoring revatimod, p<0.0001

HEPATIC SIGNAL (ALT or AST >3x ULN, any visit) - REPORTABLE AE CATEGORY, MUST BE ADDRESSED IN THE AE SUMMARY
- Revatimod: 30/941 (3.2%). Maximum observed 3.1x ULN.
- Placebo: 4/471 (0.8%).
